theme: Independent visual review of unresolved divided-face layouts
question: Which of the 29 already imaged faces lacking accepted physical order can be represented by explicit source-linked group geometry?
outcome: All 29 faces have a disposition after 29 primary and eight alternate image views. Twenty-one spatial layouts and twelve provisional catalogue-segment to graphic-group maps are supported; no historical reading traversal is assigned. Three supplemental caption, duplicate-image and main-versus-edge identity checks are recorded locally.
challenge: Faint images, unknown codes, composite panels, rotated groups and scene details can obscure segment correspondence. Both agents have historical project exposure, so the visual masking does not establish fresh evidence.
remedy: Sealed a visual-only record before source codes, retained an independently sealed parent record, rendered held catalogue glyphs only in the alignment phase, preserved original-pixel geometry and uncertainty, and kept unsupported maps unresolved. Detailed records remain local under the redistribution rules.
retry_when: Independent expert review or higher-resolution primary plates can resolve the remaining layout and source-segment correspondences. Preserve the current records when adding new assertions.

authors.model: GPT-6 family; exact backend identifier not exposed
